statement: DEMO-RC-G8-00 normal-demo 수치다. 원본 applied setup/composition은 불변이며 별도 effect state만 변한다. 승인 사격은 event_id 오름차순 stable SHA-256 roll로 명중을 정하고 같은 턴 일반 사격과 연쇄 폭발은 pre-damage snapshot에서 산출한 뒤 target별 합산한다. 실제 함선 손실만 확정하며 장수 부상·전사·포로와 최종 승패는 후속 G8-01/G8-03 경계다.
maximum_hull_policy: sum(original ship count * setup ship_type.unit_cost * hull_points_per_ship_unit_cost_point); mission equipment cost is excluded

hit.accuracy_policy: clamp(base+(shooter_fire_percent-target_total_defense_percent)*100,min,max), then multiply command_accuracy_basis_points half_up; allocation is already consumed by weapon selection and is not applied twice; estimated additionally requires sealed aim within weapon impact radius of actual core target position and multiplies confidence half_up

ship_loss_policy: floor(total_original_ships*cumulative_hull_loss/maximum_hull); monotonic; cap overkill at current hull; allocate cumulative losses by ship_type_id ascending while preserving immutable original composition
supply_ship_status_policy: G6-06 is squadron-level: apply the squadron hull damage band to every surviving SHP-05; SHP-05 removed by deterministic composition casualty allocation is destroyed; never infer per-ship hull

morale.shaken_contract: actions remain available and already-authorized current-turn actions are never retroactively cancelled
morale.retreating_contract: from next command can_attack=false and can_change_mission=false; forced_retreat=true; actual exit movement and victory consequence are G8-03

replay_policy: processed shot and chain trigger event IDs are unique forever; duplicate, malformed, or wrong-turn batch rejects without mutation
